description:
Hushfeed v0.74.0 has 135 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This one is mostly about how TikTok looks. Its red buttons can take a color you pick, the tab bar can float as a see-through pill, and the main feed can run up under the clock. LIVEs keep the quality you chose after a restart, and Hushfeed can patch PineDrama, TikTok's drama series app, where 90 of the patches work. The release notes list every report this release changed something for.

Validation: 4539 runtime tests passed and 924 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 135 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Builds with this release's changes were patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 and run on a Galaxy S22 and a Galaxy S25.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
